_source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Alchemical_Hydra and /Strategies (phases, vents, attacks, damage); monsters-complete (hitpoints, attack speed, max hits); the cache for every id. The phase forms follow the Wiki's infobox (serpentine 8615, electric 8619, flame 8620, enraged 8621). Values neither gives are marked _calibrated.

names._npcs: The gameval numbers don't follow the phase order: by the Wiki's infobox, hydraboss_4 (8619) is the electric phase and hydraboss_2 (8621) the enraged one, as monsters-complete's 4-tick, 55-max stats for 8621 agree.

combat._empoweredMaxHit: the Wiki's infobox: max hit 35 default, 52 empowered (an incorrect vent raises its damage by up to 50%)
combat._phaseHits: the Wiki's infobox, per version: serpentine 17x2 (26x2 empowered), electric 35 (26x2 empowered), flame 35 (52 empowered), extinguished 55; 'x2' is two hits an attack. Only the infobox gives the x2; no recording of the fight.
combat._calibrated: the vent cadence and how long weakening lasts, pool, lightning and fire timings

lightning._calibrated: how long a current lasts and how fast it closes in

fire._calibrated: the fire walls' damage and lifetime, and how long the tracking fire follows

kill._respawn: the Wiki infobox's 43 ticks (its Strategies page says 20 seconds)

messages.noTask: You need a hydra Slayer task to fight the Alchemical Hydra.
messages.doorLocked: The door is jammed shut while the Hydra lives.
messages.killCount: Your Alchemical Hydra kill count is: <col=ff0000>{kills}</col>.
messages.weakened: The chemicals neutralise the Alchemical Hydra's defences!
messages.empowered: The chemicals are absorbed by the Alchemical Hydra; empowering it further!
messages._unverified: noTask, doorLocked, weakened and empowered have no capture behind them; roar is the Wiki's overhead for the correct vent
